l-e-h3-b05-31.material: Na two ways to learn new words be dis. A: Cram only di Korean meaning of each word, one by one. B: Cram words as pairs wey often dey go together (for example, make a decision).
l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s1.prompt: Which method go help person use natural English pass, and why?

l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s1.r.a: Even if di number grow quick, you no go learn which words dey go together.
l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s1.o.b: B: Because you dey learn di pairs wey dey go together

l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: Even if you sabi di meaning, if you no know which words dey go together, di sentence go sound somehow.
l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s1.o.d: A: Because person no fit cram words as pairs
l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: E dey very possible to cram words as pairs.
l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Even if na only di meaning you sabi, if you no know which verb dey go with am, e go sound somehow. Cramming words as pairs teach you natural combinations.

l-e-h3-b05-31.s.s2.model.1: If you cram only di meaning, you no go sabi di pairs and e go sound somehow, so B, learning with pairs, fit pass.

l-e-h3-b06-40.goal: Weigh all di conditions wey clash for notice wey both polite and clear, choose best compromise, and explain why.
l-e-h3-b06-40.material: Refund fit only happen within 30 days. Dis na reply to customer after 30 days don pass. Conditions: e must polite, and clear say refund no possible.
l-e-h3-b06-40.s.s1.r.b: E clear but blunt, so e no polite.
l-e-h3-b06-40.s.s1.r.c: E polite, but e no clear say di answer na no.
l-e-h3-b06-40.s.s1.r.d: E polite, but e no match di facts, so na wrong information.
l-e-h3-b06-40.s.s1.explain: E talk politely with ‘Sorry’ and clearly give reason why e no possible: refunds end after 30 days.
l-e-h3-b06-40.s.s2.model.0: E show politeness with ‘Sorry’ and clearly say refunds end after 30 days, so e meet both conditions.
l-e-h3-b06-40.s.s2.model.1: E talk politely without hiding di fact say e no possible, so e meet both conditions.

l-e-h3-b07-07.title: Polite and clear noise note
l-e-h3-b07-07.topic: Note wey you leave for neighbor
l-e-h3-b07-07.goal: Weigh all di conditions wey clash for tone of note to next-door neighbor, choose best compromise, and explain why.
l-e-h3-b07-07.material: You write note to next-door neighbor. Conditions: state di time wey be di problem, no blame di other person, and ask politely.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: E blame di other person, no mention time, and no polite.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.r.b: E polite, but you no fit tell when di problem dey happen.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: E mention time, but e blame di other person.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s1.explain: ‘Please lower ... after 10 p.m.’ state di time and make request, so e no blame anybody. Di others miss at least one condition.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: E state di time, make request with ‘Please’, and no get blaming words, so e meet all three conditions.
l-e-h3-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: ‘Perhaps’ no get time and rude blame, so sentence wey get both ‘after 10 p.m.’ and ‘Please’ fit pass.
